note: EEF-delta deploy envelope for carrot_in_pot (design row A2). Joint envelope: 1.2x expanded symmetric about the centre of the OBSERVED state q only (unlike the banana joint_safety_limits.json, the recorded `command` stream is excluded from the envelope -- in this EEF-mode session it leads the measured joints by ~0.9 s, so it is not a pose the arm ever held). UR7e hard limits +/-2pi (elbow +/-pi); these are well inside. Workspace box = observed TCP min/max +/- 0.03 m, except z_lo = max(raw_z_min - 0.01, 0.0) (below the table is not a recoverable excursion). eef_max_step_* = 1.5x the largest single-frame achieved motion, rounded up (0.001 m / 0.01 rad); eef_max_lead_* = the median 30-frame (1 s) achieved motion, rounded up to 0.01. All motion statistics come from gello_policy.eef_space.delta_action on ACHIEVED joints, never from `command`. start_pose and delta_stats.frame_1 are on DE-STALED joints (linearly interpolated at cam1_t + tau_q, matching A1's converter); the joint envelope, the workspace box and frame_30 stay on the converter's tau=0 resampling, which a constant shift leaves alone and which is the wider (conservative) set because shifting drops the last 7.8% of frames off the end of the joint record. All intervals are quantised OUTWARD onto a 0.0001 grid before the derived values are computed, so joint_limits_* / workspace_* can be re-derived exactly from the joint_raw_* / workspace_raw printed in this same file.
start_pose_note: Mean over all takes of the arm's REAL pose at the instant the first camera frame was taken: joints linearly interpolated at cam1_t[0] + tau_q (the same de-staling A1's converter applies), each take first brought to the literal value nearest take 1's by ur_kin.wrapped_nearest so a +/-2pi split on wrist_3 cannot corrupt the mean. std / max_dev are on this same basis. The naive tau=0 value is kept as start_pose_unshifted for reference.
start_pose_unshifted_note: REFERENCE ONLY -- frame-0 joints read at cam1_t with no de-staling, i.e. the arm's pose ~0.89 s BEFORE the first camera frame. Frame 0 is the one quantity in this file that a constant time shift does NOT leave alone (the arm is already moving), and the two differ by up to 0.047 rad / 21 mm of TCP. Do not put this in the yaml: the pose the arm holds at arming must be the frame-0 state the policy was trained on, which is the de-staled one above.
start_branch_note: ur_kin.branch_id(start_pose); policy_leader_node locks IK to this closed-form branch. Verified on 18557 sampled frames (stride 1): 0 off-branch.
joint_state_shift_note: Per take: the shift tau that minimises median |TCP(q(t+tau)) - TCP(command(t))| over tau in [0.00, 1.50] s step 0.01. The ur_joint_states cache is stamped stale by this much while command and the cameras are fresh. Accepted range [0.6, 1.2] s with residual < 3 mm. Only delta_stats.frame_1 uses the shifted joints (the shift changes which cache sample a 30 Hz frame snaps to, which inflates single-frame motion); the joint envelope, start pose, workspace box and frame_30 statistics are invariant to a constant time shift and stay on the converter's own resampling. Why the cache is stale is A7's row, not this one.

workspace_raw.note: observed TCP min/max, quantised outward to 0.0001 m

delta_stats.source: eef_space.delta_action on achieved joints, cam1 master clock (30 fps)

frame_1.joints: cam1_t + tau_q, LINEAR interpolation (A1's converter recipe); drives eef_max_step_*
frame_1.jitter_note: Why interpolation and not nearest: the joint cache runs at ~66.7 Hz with a jittery dt (median 15.8 ms, p99 25.9 ms), so nearest-timestamp resampling at 30 Hz snaps to a 2- or 3-sample gap, and tau_q = 0.89 s lands the master grid on a bad phase where 8.8% of frames repeat a sample (zero motion) and 24% jump 3. That inflates the single-frame motion to p99 7.9 / max 11.5 mm (see frame_1_destaled_nearest) although the arm never moved that fast. Interpolating the same shifted grid gives p99 6.6 / max 8.9 mm, and it is what A1's converter does -- so these are the actions the policy is actually trained to emit, and the clamp is sized on them. REGENERATE this file if A1 changes the resampling again.

frame_1_destaled_nearest.joints: cam1_t + tau_q, nearest-timestamp; audit only, nothing derived

frame_1_unshifted.joints: converter resampling (tau=0); audit only, nothing is derived from it

frame_30.joints: converter resampling (tau=0); invariant to a constant shift
